title: Penthouse June 1994 Taylor Wane 5-Girl Pet Play-Off Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers bright; a few small white ink-loss specks on the lower front cover. Spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, June 1994 - All New! Special 5-Girl Pet Play-Off. Original $4.95 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Taylor Wane.

Cover features: Exclusive - the Bobbitt case; Menendez murder trivia; The real villains in the Pollard spy scandal.

Back cover: Absolut Hofmekler vodka ad (homage to Toulouse-Lautrec).

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
